rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding enumeration
fused form of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulaṃ; compound expressing attainment of powers as the root Kaula

items.question: What additional attainment constitutes the root Kaula for the fair-faced goddess?
premises: Eight attainments are enumerated in this context
The attainment of powers is identified as the root Kaula
items.inference: The attainment of powers, as the eighth, is declared to be the root Kaula
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight attainments depends on the preceding verses
items.plain_english: And the eight attainments, culminating in the attainment of powers, constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
